103:     def initialize(self) -> None:
104:         """Initialize the connection to the MCP server.
105: 
106:         Raises:
107:             Exception: If initialization fails
108:         """
109:         if not self.connected:
110:             self.transport.connect()
111:             self.connected = True
112: 
113:         # Send initialize request
114:         init_request = self._build_request(
115:             "initialize",
116:             {
117:                 "protocolVersion": "2025-03-26",
118:                 "capabilities": {
119:                     "roots": {"listChanged": True},
120:                     "sampling": {},
121:                 },
122:                 "clientInfo": {
123:                     "name": "ansible-mcp-client",
124:                     "version": "1.0.0",
125:                 },
126:             },
127:         )
128: 
129:         response = self.transport.request(init_request)
130: 
131:         # Cache server info from response
132:         if "result" in response:
133:             self._server_info = response["result"]
134:         else:
135:             raise Exception(
136:                 f"Initialization failed: {response.get('error', 'Error in initialization')}"
137:             )
138: 
139:         # Send initialized notification
140:         initialized_notification = self._build_notification("notifications/initialized")
141:         self.transport.notify(initialized_notification)

143:     def list_tools(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
144:         """List all available tools from the MCP server.
145: 
146:         Returns:
147:             Dictionary containing the tools list response
148: 
149:         Raises:
150:             Exception: If the request fails
151:         """
152:         # Return cached result if available
153:         if self._tools_cache is not None:
154:             return self._tools_cache
155: 
156:         # Make request to server
157:         request = self._build_request("tools/list")
158: 
159:         response = self.transport.request(request)
160: 
161:         if "result" in response:
162:             self._tools_cache = response["result"]
163:             return self._tools_cache
164:         else:
165:             raise Exception(
166:                 f"Failed to list tools: {response.get('error', 'Error in listing tools')}"
167:             )

169:     def get_tool(self, tool: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
170:         """Get the definition of a specific tool.
171: 
172:         Args:
173:             tool: Name of the tool to retrieve
174: 
175:         Returns:
176:             Dictionary containing the tool definition
177: 
178:         Raises:
179:             ValueError: If the tool is not found
180:         """
181:         tools_response = self.list_tools()
182:         tools = tools_response.get("tools", [])
183: 
184:         for tool_def in tools:
185:             if tool_def.get("name") == tool:
186:                 return tool_def
187: 
188:         raise ValueError(f"Tool '{tool}' not found")
